about_what_body_1: FAIR stands for Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable. These principles describe how to manage research data and other digital objects so that people and machines can find and reuse them.
about_what_body_2: A FAIR assessment checks an object against those principles. Some tools run the checks automatically. Others guide a person through a questionnaire or describe a framework.
about_verified_body_1: Each entry shows a status and the date it was last verified. A maintainer opens the resource by hand and records the result on that date.
about_verified_body_2: Entries that were not verified in the last {days} days carry a note saying so.
about_verified_body_3: A link and freshness report runs every week. It lists links that do not respond as expected and entries that are due for a new check. A response from a server does not guarantee that the tool works; for that reason, a maintainer reviews each case manually.
about_suggest_body: To propose a new entry or a correction, follow the contribution guide in the project repository.
